title: Use Claude Code from your phone alone (cloud)

steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
Using only your phone, you'll give Claude a job and land the result in your notes repository (my-notes). Your computer can be off.

  • Time: 15 minutes
  • You need: the my-notes repository from Phone 2, and the Claude phone app

steps.title: First, how the cloud works
steps.html:
The biggest difference from before: no permission cards. Instead, there's this safety net.

Send a jobClaude works on its ownSaved to a new branchyou reviewOnly merging changes the original
BranchA side copy for changes, leaving the original (main) untouched
PR (pull request)A review request: "May I merge this branch into the original?"
MergeYou check it and combine it into the original. Only then does my-notes change

steps.title: Send a job from your phone
steps.html:
1. Claude phone app → Code in the menu.
  2. Under the typing box, set the repository to my-notes and leave the branch as main. (Environment: Default)
  3. Send the sentence below.

Unlike Phone 1's green-dot chat (your computer), this is a new chat where you pick a repository.
steps.alt: Picking the my-notes repository in Code on the phone and sending a job
steps.code: Create todo.md and write 5 example to-dos for this week

check.q: Did you pick my-notes and send it?

steps.title: If you can't pick the repository
steps.html:
• If my-notes isn't listed, check the 'Install the app' step in Phone 2.
  • If the app struggles, opening claude.ai/code in your phone browser works the same way.

steps.title: Wait, then check the result
steps.html:
Setting up and working in the cloud can take a few minutes. It keeps working even if you close the app. Reopen the chat when it's done.

  1. When you see that it pushed to a new branch and a Changes count (e.g. +7), it's finished.
  2. Tap the Changes numbers to see what changed. If the app doesn't show it, open the same chat at claude.ai/code in your phone browser.
steps.alt: After finishing, Changes and a Create PR button appear

check.q: Is it done, and did you check the changes (todo.md)?

steps.title: If it's slow or seems stuck
steps.html:
• The first run takes longer while the cloud computer gets ready. Give it about 5 minutes.
  • Claude may have asked you something. Open the chat and answer.
  • Idle sessions can pause. Reopen the chat and say "carry on".

steps.title: Create a PR (review request)
steps.html:
Right now todo.md only exists on the new branch. To merge it into the original, first make a PR.

  • If you see a Create PR button, tap it. The title and description are filled in for you.
  • No button? Send "Create a PR" in the chat.

check.q: Was the PR created? (You'll see a GitHub link or a note that a pull request was opened)

steps.title: If the PR won't create
steps.html:
• Open the same chat at claude.ai/code in your phone browser; the Create PR button is there.
  • Or make it on GitHub: my-notes repository → the yellow bar's Compare & pull request → Create pull request.

steps.title: Check and merge on GitHub
steps.html:
1. In your phone browser (or the GitHub app): github.com → my-notes → Pull requests → the PR you just made.
  2. Check todo.md once more under Files changed.
  3. If it's fine: Merge pull request → Confirm merge.
  4. When todo.md shows on my-notes' front page (Code), you're done!
Merging is your final permission. Instead of permission cards, read it here before tapping. Don't like it? Don't merge; ask Claude to fix it.
steps.alt: Checking Files changed on a GitHub PR and tapping Merge pull request

check.q: Can you see todo.md on my-notes' front page?

steps.title: If merging doesn't work
steps.html:
• A grey Merge button means a conflict. Tell Claude "Resolve the PR conflict."
  • Want changes? In the same chat say something like "Cut it to 3 to-dos." It updates the same PR.

steps.title: Next time · be careful
steps.html:
• Continue the same job: reopen that chat in the app's Code list and keep talking.
  • New job: start a new chat and pick my-notes. Each time: new branch → PR → merge.
  • You can see Claude's files any time in the GitHub app or on github.com.
  • Usage: the cloud uses the same limits as chat and desktop. (Desktop 8)
  • No sensitive data: keep passwords, account numbers and other people's personal data out of the repository.
  • You may not get a done notification: check the app now and then.

steps.title: 🎉 Phone practice 3 done! Jobs without a computer
steps.html:
Now you can hand Claude jobs from just your phone, even on your commute.

Phone 1Control your computer (left on) from your phone; files stay on your computer
Phone 3Work happens in the cloud and lands in a GitHub repository; your computer can be off

Three things to remember

  1. No permission cards in the cloud. Instead: new branch → PR → merge.
  2. Always read Files changed before merging. Merging is your final permission.
  3. Keep the repository private, and keep sensitive data out.
